headline: Chinese Stocks Rise on Reports of Industry Support Meetings
summary: China's CSI 300 Index rose 0.8% and the Star 50 jumped 3.1% following reports that regulators plan to meet industry participants to discuss market support measures.
why: Chinese regulators frequently engage domestic market participants to coordinate stability measures during equity downturns.

impacts.name: CSI 300 Index
impacts.why: Reports of planned regulatory support measures improved market sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor expectations of government intervention helped lift Chinese benchmark indices after a long decline.
